parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the main switch part of the object, made of ABS plastic, typically rectangular with a slightly curved surface for pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that toggles the electrical connection on or off when pressed or flipped.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly or pivots slightly when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the switch, made of durable polycarbonate, providing structural support and housing for the internal mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch mechanism in place and provides mounting points for installation on a wall or device.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation, serving as a stable support structure.
